name: Semester Registration
steps: Access the Student Management System (SEMS) portal through the university website.
Log in with Roll Number and password, then verify personal and academic profile details.
Select core and elective courses for the current semester as per the curriculum.
Pay the prescribed semester tuition and hostel fees via the integrated online payment gateway.
Download and print the registration confirmation slip for submission to the Head of Department (HOD).
documents_required: Bank Passbook (copy for scholarship auto-credit verification)
deadline: Typically within 10-15 days of the semester commencement date.
university_scope: Anna University (typical), similar across TN universities

name: Exam Form Submission
steps: Log in to the Controller of Examinations (COE) student portal during the application window.
Verify the list of regular subjects for the current semester.
Select arrear (backlog) subjects if applicable from the previous semesters.
Pay the examination fee per paper through digital payment (Net Banking/UPI/Card).
Confirm the examination center and download the Hall Ticket once generated.
documents_required: Digital Passport Size Photograph (for Hall Ticket)
Previous Semester Marklists (to verify arrear subject codes)
deadline: Usually 30 days before the start of the end-semester examinations (typically Apr/Nov).
university_scope: Anna University (typical), similar across TN universities

name: Revaluation Process
steps: Check the published results on the official university portal.
Apply for the digital photocopy of the answer script within the stipulated time.
Pay the photocopy fee per subject online.
Review the answer script with the subject teacher/expert to identify marking discrepancies.
If discrepancies exist, submit the formal application for revaluation/review and pay the revaluation fee.
deadline: Strictly within 7 days of result publication (Photocopy) and 7 days after receiving photocopy (Revaluation).
university_scope: Anna University (typical), similar across TN universities
